verdict.rationale: Cursor has a dedicated first-party 'Agent Skills' feature: portable, version-controlled packages that teach agents domain-specific tasks, auto-discovered at startup, invocable via '/' in chat, with built-in managed skills plus user-added ones (cursor-docs-36, cursor-supp-skills). This is complemented by a marketplace to add plugins/skills/MCPs/rules from one place (cursor-docs-5) and rules for custom workflows (cursor-docs-35), giving strong ecosystem support for custom capabilities. Missing for 10: independent/community hands-on validation of the skills feature specifically (only vendor docs cited).
